main_text.l: Part. Præterit. בָּנָה [?] Ædificata fuerat, Esr. 5.11. Infinit. לִבְנוֹת [?] Ædificare, Esr. 5.2. vel מ ejecto & per Dagesch compensato, לְבַנָּא [?]; v.3. Cum ה paragogico, לִבְנֹיָה [?] Ædificandi, v. 9. Futur. יִבְנֶה [?] Ædificanto [?]; Esr. 6.7. Niph. Præter. נִבְנָה [?] Aedificata fuerat, 1.Reg. 3.2. Part. הַנִּבְנֶה [?] Quæ ædificata fuerit, 1.Par. 22.19. Infin. לְהִבָּנוֹת [?] Ut ædificaretur, Hag. 1.2. Futur. אִבָּנֶה [?] Ædificabor; Liberos consequar, Genes. 16.2. & 30.3. Chald. ex Ithp. Partic. מִתְבַּנֶּא [?] Ædificatur, Esr. 5.8. Futur. יִתְבְּנָא [?] Ædificabitur, v. 6. תִּתְבְּנָא [?] Ædificabitur, Esr. 4.13.
בִּנְיָן [?] m. Idem, vers. 12. Chald. בִּנְיָנָא [?] Esr. 5.4.
מִבְנָה [?] in. Structura: Constr. כִּמְבְנֵה־עִיר [?] Quasi structura civitatis, Ezech. 40.2.
תַּבְנִית [?] f. Structura: Similitudo, Exemplar, Forma: Aff. תַּבְנִיתוֹ [?] Similitudinem illius, 2.Reg. 16.10.

בֵּן [?] m. Filius, latè: Gener, 1.Sam. 24.17. Pullus, Lev. 12. v. 6. Ramus, Genes. 49.22. Psalm. 80. 16. Constr. בֶּן [?]; & quandoq בֵּן [?], ut Deuter. 25. 2. Cum י paragogico, בְּנִי בְעוֹר [?] Filius Behoris, Numer. 24. v. 3: cui simile vide in Nomine חָיֵי [?]: Aff. בְּנוֹ [?] Filius ejus; בְּנִי [?] Filius meus, בִּנְךָ [?] Filius tuus; בְּנֵנוּ [?] Filius noster, &c. Plural: בָּנִים [?] Filii; Nepotes, Posteri: Pulli, Job. 39.19. Discipuli, doctrinâ & institutione filii. Vide R. Salomon. Deuteron. 6. v. 7. Constr. בְּנֵי [?] Gen. 6. v. 21. Aff. וּבְנֵיהֶם [?] Et pulli earum, Gen. 32.15. בָּנָיו [?] Filii ejus, Genes. 46.7. Chald. בְּנֵי [?] Filii, Dan. 2. 25. וּבְנֵי תוֹרִין [?] Et filii boum, id est, Juvenci, Esr. 6.9. בְּנֵיהוֹן [?] Filii eorum, Dan. 6.24. וּבִנָּוֹהִי [?] Et filiorum ejus, Esr. 6.10.
בַּת [?] f. Filia, quasi ex בִּנְּת [?], ut Dagesch ostendit in formâ Affixorum, tùm etiam ejus Plurale. Sic est אַף [?] Ira, ex אָנַף [?]. Metaphoricè quoq, hoc nomine appellantur Oppida, Pagi

page.notes: Printed Hebrew throughout is set in a small, blurred type. Hebrew vowel points and dagesh are uncertain, so every Hebrew word is marked [?]. Several Hebrew words in the Chaldee and Niphal forms could not be read with certainty and are transcribed as best as possible. The page number "79" and the running head at the top centre are blurred. Esr. 6.7 "Ædificanto" and Gen. 6. v. 21 are doubtful as printed. The last entry's Hebrew (אַף / אָנַף) is partly illegible. The line ending "Oppida," runs on to the catchword "Pagi".
